text:
emily: opened a small PR to update the migration guide and the Ruby SDK snippet. preview build failed with a missing SVG and one linkredirect. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/601

paul: are examples covered by CODEOWNERS? I think only /docs/** is listed today. examples often sit unreviewed.

preview-bot: docs-preview: FAILED
Error: GET /static/icons/logo-small.svg -> 404 while rendering docs/migration-guide/sdk.md

emily: it's docs/examples-only (docs/ + examples/ruby/snippet.rb). no runtime changes. I can inline the SVG for preview.

rachel: long-term we should add /examples/** to CODEOWNERS so @redwood/docs gets auto-assigned. If we do that we need an auto-merge policy for tiny docs fixes so reviewers aren't overloaded.

ci-bot: idea: auto-merge allowed only when ALL true: (1) label `docs/auto-merge` added by a human user, (2) required checks pass: docs-preview, md-lint, linkcheck, (3) PR only modifies docs/ or examples/, (4) PR does NOT modify CODEOWNERS or infra files, (5) no changed path matches regex `(examples/private/|\.env$|credentials|PRIVATE_KEY)`, (6) not during release-freeze window.

paul: add safety: workflow must verify the label addition actor is a User (not a Bot) and run a grep scan for credential-like strings: `git diff --name-only ... | xargs grep -E "(PRIVATE_KEY|AWS_SECRET|SECRET_KEY)"`. fail if matches.

emily: OK I'll inline the missing asset and re-run. I'll also open a tiny CODEOWNERS PR to add examples once we agree automation.

rachel: also: if a PR modifies CODEOWNERS, explicitly disable auto-merge for that PR and require admin approval. editing CODEOWNERS can expand reviewers and needs manual oversight.

ci-bot: workflow suggestion (pseudo): on: pull_request.labeled if label == 'docs/auto-merge' and github.event.sender.type == 'User' -> run path-safety script -> check not touching CODEOWNERS -> call release-bot API for freeze status -> if green, merge via squash and post audit comment with actor, checks, and merge SHA.

paul: audit comment is important for SRE/legal. make it include PR number, who requested the label, and the merge commit SHA + timestamp.

emily: thanks all. action items: emily inline asset + open CODEOWNERS PR, rachel draft CODEOWNERS change, paul draft GH workflow with blocklist + user guard + freeze check, ci-bot to post an example audit comment template. I'll request the label after CODEOWNERS merges.

(Action summary: emily -> fix preview asset & open CODEOWNERS PR, paulf -> draft workflow, rachel -> open CODEOWNERS change, ci-bot -> provide audit comment snippet)
